out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AT HANDWASHING SINK AT THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. CDI: PIC AND CFM WERE RE-EDUCATED ON DATING SHELLSTOCK TAGS AS INDICATED ABOVE. HAMROCK'S RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 08/07/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. CDI: CFM PLACED TAG BACK WITH THE SHELLSTOCK. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED IN (4): RAW SHELL EGGS STORED OVER COOKED MEATLOAF.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: EGGS MOVED TO THE BOTTOM OF THE COOLER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: OBSERVED PLATES AND BOWLS RUN THROUGH THE DISHWASHER WHEN IT WAS AT 0PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: ALL DISHWARE WERE SANITIZED PROPERLY IN THE THREE-VAT SINK.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (2): ITALIAN SAUSAGE AT 38-44F, COOKED PASTA AT 42-46F OBSERVED IN (3): COOKED BRUSSEL SPROUTS AT 47F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS FOODS OVER 43F WERE DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: OBSERVED DISCLOSURE STATEMENT MISSING FROM THE BOTTOM OF THE PAPER MENU. OBSERVED ON EGGS ON THE BRUNCH MENU AVAILABLE TO BE COOKED TO ORDER WITHOUT AN ASTERISK.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PAPER MENU WAS CORRECTED DURING INSPECTION. BRUNCH MENU WAS EDITED DURING INSPECTION, BUT MUST BE PRINTED WITH CORRECT CONSUMER ADVISORY. YOU CAN USE MARKER ON EACH MENU TO ASTERISK THE EGGS. PLEASE SEND ME PROOF OF THIS CORRECTION BY AUGUST 17TH.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw pork being stored over raw salmon in the 2 door prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). Pic rearranged 2 door prep top so the raw fish was being stored over the raw breaded pork cutlet

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. RAID observed under the 2 vat sink at the bar
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of the raid

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed lobster bisque and marinara sauce being stored in the 2 door upright cooler
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC had chef make labels for TCS foods made on site

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed in the 2 door prep top cooler raw beef and pork being stored over RTE cheese slices
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC rearranged fridge so cheese was no longer being stored under beef/ pork

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: oil and white wine
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC agreed to label the white wine and oil containers
